description: Read Fastmail mail with a JMAP API token: folders, messages, threads, search, and attachment download. listMessages filters include from, to, subject, text, after, before, folder, and alias (From, To, Cc, or Bcc). listAliases lists sending identities and Fastmail masked addresses. With read-write access: sendMessage (choose a From alias and attach session files), replyMessage (reply or reply-all, including from another alias), createFolder, moveMessages, archiveMessages, and deleteMessage, which moves mail to Trash. destroyMessage permanently deletes. Enable Email on the token; sending also needs Email submission, and masked addresses need Masked Email.
name: Fastmail
setup: In Fastmail Settings → Privacy & Security → Manage API tokens, select the JMAP protocol and enable Email, Email submission, and Masked Email. MCP and Dynamic DNS tokens are not supported. Choose Read-only access for reading, or Read-write access to send, reply, move, archive, or delete mail. API tokens require a plan above Basic. Your token stays on this server.
